provenanceFamily: US Department of State FRUS edited series

documents.finding: June 19 JCS 911683 authorized attacks on Yalu hydroelectric facilities with State, Defense and presidential approval; June 23 strikes. Editorial note, not reproduced signed directive.
Bruce telegram Tosec 14 reports Selwyn Lloyd's nine-point proposal, US consideration rather than immediate adoption, and UK objection to Yalu bombing without consultation.
Rhee letter to Truman alleges communist conspiracy among Assemblymen and defends martial law; allegations not established by letter. Editorial footnote documents Aug 13 decision not to reply.

executed_by: UN air and naval air forces

claims.statement: UK nine-point program was adopted as an ultimatum by June 24

Prior US-UK agreement required consultation before June 23 bombing
claims.note: UK asserted implied commitment; US representatives disputed existence of binding consultation undertaking
